
=== WebPanel: Produccion.listarInventario ===

--- Start (Event) ---
form.Caption = 'Fechas de reinicio de contadores'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_InventarioInicioConsecutivoAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFInventarioFechaHora_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_InventarioFechaHoraAuxDateText.InternalName)
	
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	Form.Caption = ' Inventario'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		&OrderedDsc = True
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarInventarioColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarInventarioColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	InventarioFechaHora.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	InventarioInicioConsecutivo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InventarioFechaHora'
					&TFInventarioFechaHora.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFInventarioFechaHora_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFInventarioFechaHora_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFInventarioFechaHora_To.Set(&TFInventarioFechaHora_To.Year(), &TFInventarioFechaHora_To.Month(), &TFInventarioFechaHora_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InventarioInicioConsecutivo'
					&TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To.Set(&TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To.Year(), &TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To.Month(), &TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Display = "GXM_display"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Display)
		&Display.Link = gestionarInventario.Link(TrnMode.Display, InventarioId)
	Endif
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = gestionarInventario.Link(TrnMode.Update, InventarioId)
	Endif
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = gestionarInventario.Link(TrnMode.Delete, InventarioId)
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'Produccion.listarInventarioColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'Produccion.listarInventarioFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'Produccion.listarInventarioFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'Produccion.listarInventarioFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DocmdAgregar' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_cmdAgregar)
		gestionarInventario.Call(TrnMode.Insert, &InventarioId)
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Transaction: DB.Inventario ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	&Insert_InventarioProductoId.SetEmpty()
	
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated InventarioProductoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"InventarioProductoId"
					&Insert_InventarioProductoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated InventarioProductoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"InventarioProductoId"
					&Insert_InventarioProductoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	
    [web]
    {
	InventarioProductoId.Visible = False
	InventarioProductoNombre.Visible = False
	InventarioInicioConsecutivo.Visible = False
	InventarioCantidad.Visible = False
	}
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		WWInventario()
	Endif
	
	Return
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	AuditTransaction.Call(&AuditingObject,&pgmname)	
   [web]
   {
	
	Return
   }
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&InventarioId);

InventarioId = &InventarioId if not &InventarioId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(InventarioId);
noprompt(InventarioId);

InventarioProductoId = &Insert_InventarioProductoId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_InventarioProductoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(InventarioProductoId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_InventarioProductoId.IsEmpty();
}

LoadAuditInventario.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, InventarioId, &Mode) on beforeUpdate;
LoadAuditInventario.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, InventarioId, &Mode) on beforeDelete;
LoadAuditInventario.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, InventarioId, &Mode) If Insert on BeforeComplete;
LoadAuditInventario.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, InventarioId, &Mode) If Update on BeforeComplete;
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
// parm(in:&Mode, in:&InventarioId);

InventarioId = &InventarioId if not &InventarioId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(InventarioId);
noprompt(InventarioId);

InventarioProductoId = &Insert_InventarioProductoId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_InventarioProductoId.IsEmpty();

=== WebPanel: Produccion.gestionarInventario ===

--- Start (Event) ---
&AuditTableName = !'Inventario'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&LoadSuccess = True
	If (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Display)
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert AND WWPBaseObjects.SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'inventario_Insert'))
		OR (&TrnMode = GeneXus.TrnMode.Update AND WWPBaseObjects.SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'inventario_Update'))
		OR (&TrnMode = GeneXus.TrnMode.Delete AND WWPBaseObjects.SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'inventario_Delete'))
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Insert
			&Inventario.Load(&InventarioId)
			&LoadSuccess = &Inventario.Success()
			If not &LoadSuccess
				&Messages = &Inventario.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Display OR &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				Inventario_InventarioFechaHora.Enabled = False
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		&LoadSuccess = False
	EndIf
	If &LoadSuccess
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
			msg('GXM_confdelete')
		EndIf
	EndIf
	Do 'AttributesSecurityCode'
	wcAuditoria.Object = AuditHistoryById.Create(&AuditTableName, &InventarioId)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Enter (Event) ---
&Inventario.InventarioProductoId.SetNull()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Display
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Delete
			Do 'CheckRequiredFields'
		EndIf
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete OR &CheckRequiredFieldsResult
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				&Inventario.Delete()
			Else
				&Inventario.Save()
			EndIf
			If &Inventario.Success()
				Do 'After_Trn'
			Else
				&Messages = &Inventario.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
parm(in:&TrnMode, in:&InventarioId);
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: Produccion.listarInventarioExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"listarInventarioExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInventarioFechaHora.IsEmpty() AND &TFInventarioFechaHora_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Fecha Hora de Reinicio de Consecutivo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Date = &TFInventarioFechaHora
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Date = &TFInventarioFechaHora_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo.IsEmpty() AND &TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Inicio Consecutivo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Date = &TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Date = &TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarInventarioColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarInventarioColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.Inventario
		order InventarioFechaHora  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InventarioFechaHora)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InventarioInicioConsecutivo  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InventarioInicioConsecutivo)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using listarInventarioDS(&FilterFullText, &TFInventarioFechaHora, &TFInventarioFechaHora_To, &TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo, &TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'InventarioFechaHora'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = InventarioFechaHora
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'InventarioInicioConsecutivo'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = InventarioInicioConsecutivo
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"InventarioFechaHora", '', !'Fecha Hora de Reinicio de Consecutivo', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"InventarioInicioConsecutivo", '', !'Inicio Consecutivo', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'Produccion.listarInventarioColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarInventarioGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarInventarioGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarInventarioGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINVENTARIOFECHAHORA"
				&TFInventarioFechaHora.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFInventarioFechaHora_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINVENTARIOINICIOCONSECUTIVO"
				&TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'BeforeWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'AfterWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(out:&Filename, out:&ErrorMessage);

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: Produccion.listarInventarioExportReport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = WWPBaseObjects.SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'listarinventario_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Inventario List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInventarioFechaHora.IsEmpty() AND &TFInventarioFechaHora_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFInventarioFechaHora
		&TFInventarioFechaHora_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Fecha Hora de Reinicio de Consecutivo", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFInventarioFechaHora_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo.IsEmpty() AND &TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFInventarioInicioConsecutivo
		&TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Inicio Consecutivo", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.Inventario
		order InventarioFechaHora  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InventarioFechaHora)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InventarioInicioConsecutivo  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InventarioInicioConsecutivo)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using listarInventarioDS(&FilterFullText, &TFInventarioFechaHora, &TFInventarioFechaHora_To, &TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo, &TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To)

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarInventarioGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarInventarioGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarInventarioGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINVENTARIOFECHAHORA"
				&TFInventarioFechaHora.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFInventarioFechaHora_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINVENTARIOINICIOCONSECUTIVO"
				&TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFInventarioInicioConsecutivo_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'BeforePrintLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'AfterPrintLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintFooter'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

Output_file("listarInventarioExportReport","PDF");

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: DB.LoadAuditInventario ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

If &SaveOldValues = !'Y'
	If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Delete or &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
		Do 'LoadOldValues'
	EndIf
Else
	Do 'LoadNewValues'
EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadOldValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each Inventario
		Where InventarioId = &InventarioId
		&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
		&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

		&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'Inventario'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode
		&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InventarioId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new DB.AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioProductoId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InventarioProductoId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new DB.AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioProductoNombre'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto Nombre'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InventarioProductoNombre.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioFechaHora'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Fecha Hora'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InventarioFechaHora.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioInicioConsecutivo'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Inicio Consecutivo'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InventarioInicioConsecutivo.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioCantidad'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Cantidad'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InventarioCantidad.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadNewValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each Inventario
		Where InventarioId = &InventarioId
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Insert

			&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
			&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'Inventario'
			&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InventarioId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioProductoId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InventarioProductoId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioProductoNombre'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto Nombre'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InventarioProductoNombre.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioFechaHora'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Fecha Hora'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InventarioFechaHora.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioInicioConsecutivo'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Inicio Consecutivo'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InventarioInicioConsecutivo.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioCantidad'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Cantidad'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InventarioCantidad.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		EndIf
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
			For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InventarioId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioProductoId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InventarioProductoId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioProductoNombre'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InventarioProductoNombre.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioFechaHora'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InventarioFechaHora.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioInicioConsecutivo'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InventarioInicioConsecutivo.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InventarioCantidad'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InventarioCantidad.ToString()

						EndCase
					EndFor
			EndFor
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(in:&SaveOldValues, inout:&AuditingObject, in: &InventarioId, in:&ActualMode);

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: DB.ViewInventario ===

--- Start (Event) ---
If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	For each
		Where InventarioId = &InventarioId
		Form.Caption = InventarioProductoNombre.ToString()
		ViewAll.Link = WWInventario.Link()
		&Exists = True
	When none
		Form.Caption = "Record not found"
		ViewAll.Visible = false
		&Exists = False
	Endfor
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	If &Exists
		&SelectedTabCode = &TabCode
		Tab.ActivePageControlName = &SelectedTabCode
		Do 'Load Tab'
	Endif

--- Tab.TabChanged (Event) ---
&SelectedTabCode = Tab.ActivePageControlName
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	Do 'Load Tab'

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&InventarioId, in:&TabCode);


=== WebPanel: DB.WWInventario ===

--- Start (Event) ---
If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	Grid.Rows = 10
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	Form.Caption = 'Inventarios'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Grid.LoadSessionState()

--- Refresh (Event) ---
Grid.SaveSessionState()

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
&Update.Link = Inventario.Link(TrnMode.Update, InventarioId)
	&Delete.Link = Inventario.Link(TrnMode.Delete, InventarioId)
	InventarioProductoNombre.Link = ViewInventario.Link(InventarioId, "")

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
Inventario(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(InventarioId))
